headline: Banks update fixed deposit interest rates for November 2026
hook: Banks adjust deposit rates after RBI hike
summary: Following the RBI's 25 bps repo rate hike, several Indian banks have revised their fixed deposit interest rates. Suryoday Small Finance Bank is currently offering a top rate of 8.60% for customers. Other institutions, including Kotak Mahindra Bank, Axis Bank, Canara Bank, and Utkarsh SFB, have also updated their offerings for general and senior citizen depositors. These adjustments reflect the broader banking sector's response to the recent shift in monetary policy.
why_it_matters: Higher interest income for your fixed deposit savings.

headline: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank posts sixth consecutive quarterly loss
hook: Six straight quarters in the red
summary: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank reported a net loss of Rs 70 crore for the second quarter, driven by heavy provisions totaling Rs 166 crore against an operating profit of Rs 85 crore. The lender's gross non-performing asset ratio improved slightly to 5.96% by the end of September, while its gross loan portfolio grew 7.5% year-on-year to Rs 20,062 crore. Retail investors holding the stock face sustained asset quality pressures and persistent bottom-line weakness.
why_it_matters: Persistent losses weigh on the bank's stock valuation.

headline: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank submits investor presentation to the exchange
hook: Routine investor deck released by Utkarsh
summary: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank has formally submitted its latest investor presentation to the stock exchanges. Such filings provide stakeholders with updated metrics regarding the bank's loan book, asset quality, and financial performance. Retail shareholders can review these presentations to track the bank's operational progress and strategic growth plans. The filing is a procedural corporate update with no immediate direct impact on stock valuation.
why_it_matters: Provides granular operational data for bank shareholders to analyze.
